encore-assets-v9-prompts.json.name: throw
encore-assets-v9-prompts.json.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D side-scroller animation sprite atlas. References are exact character/style references for Nige Hood. Preserve his face, curly dark afro, short beard, warm medium brown complexion, olive jacket and olive loose trousers, white shirt, white low-top sneakers, painterly game-art shading and crisp dark contour. Create exactly FOUR full-body right-facing frames in an evenly spaced 2 COLUMN x 2 ROW grid on a transparent square canvas. One frame per quadrant, generous gutters. All feet visible and planted in a stable casual standing stance, consistent anatomy/head size/physical scale. Align soles at the same baseline within each row. Animation is a quick casual one-handed BASEBALL-STYLE THROW starting BESIDE THE EAR and throwing slightly DOWNWARD to screen right. Do not depict a punch or a two-hand push. Top-left frame 1: throwing hand cocked beside ear, fingers curled as if holding a small ball, elbow bent, off hand relaxed near waist; slight backward shoulder turn. Top-right frame 2: throwing elbow drives forward with slight torso twist, hand moves forward past cheek toward release, off arm balancing low; feet remain stable. Bottom-left frame 3: release, throwing arm straight forward and approximately 15 degrees downward, hand open in natural release, chest turned slightly, chin toward target; off hand remains down. Bottom-right frame 4: relaxed follow-through, throwing hand has swept down past hip, torso easing back upright, both knees soft, no crossed arms. No huge baseball pitcher's leg lift. No airborne frames. Do NOT paint any ball, flame, glow, magical effect, floor, shadow, words, grid lines, labels or numbers. Just four isolated complete opaque character cutouts with genuinely transparent background and clean alpha edges.

encore-assets-v9-dive-prompts.json.initial: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent two-frame 2D platform-game dive sprite atlas for Encore. References are the exact Nige Hood character; preserve his identity, curly black afro, short beard, warm medium-brown skin, olive green jacket and matching pants, white tee and white low-top sneakers, clean dark contours and rich illustrated shading. Create exactly TWO distinct full-body airborne right-facing frames in TWO COLUMNS and ONE ROW on a wide canvas. Each isolated character centered in his own half with generous empty transparent separation. Consistent physical head and body scale between both poses. LEFT FRAME: transition into a dive from a front flip: knees softly tucked, torso bends forward and rotates slightly clockwise into a rightward/downward lean, arms starting to reach toward lower-right, compact athletic silhouette, head looks down-right. RIGHT FRAME: decisive ATHLETIC DIAGONAL FORWARD AND DOWN DIVE. Whole body axis runs UPPER LEFT to LOWER RIGHT at about 45 degrees downward. Both sneakered feet trail in the upper-left, hips in the upper-left of center, torso leans diagonally down-right, head is ahead of torso toward lower-right, one leading arm reaches toward lower-right and the other slightly bent alongside it; hands and head lead the descent. Natural parkour/superhero diving pose, loose jacket and pants follow the body. Clean readable silhouette and recognizable face in right profile. This is clearly descending diagonally, not upward flight and not a rigid straight vertical headfirst fall. No violent collision or injury, no ground, no props, no floor shadow, no motion lines, no streaks, no fire or glow baked into the image. Both entire figures including hands and feet fit inside their respective halves. Genuine transparent background and clean alpha edges, no text, numbers, borders or checkerboard.
